description: Explore advanced cuSOLVER Xpotrf parameters, algorithm variants, workspace persistence, and shape-specific direct schedules for n=256 through 4096 and low/high batches. Preserve the validated n=32/64/128 custom kernels and existing mixed large-shape fallback; benchmark crossovers systematically and pursue only measured improvements.

Replace looped classic Spotrf for batch<=4,n>=1024 with generic Xpotrf ALG_0 while retaining BF16x9 math mode; cache the params object and shape-scoped device/host byte workspaces. Validation and fresh-seed guards passed. Full-grid geomean measured 1291.615 us; looped cells measured 1224.754 us at batch=4,n=1024, 1252.086 us at batch=2,n=2048, and 1429.894/2870.094 us at n=4096.

Extend persistent looped Xpotrf from batch<=4 to batch=8 at n=2048. Validation and guards passed. The batch=8,n=2048 cell rose from 4719.259 us with potrfBatched to 5074.638 us with eight Xpotrf calls; full geomean rose from 1291.615 to 1298.516 us.

Restore potrfBatched at batch=8,n=2048 and request CUSOLVER_ALLOW_NON_DETERMINISTIC_RESULTS for both direct execution and Xpotrf workspace queries. Validation and guards passed. Full geomean measured 1292.007 us versus 1291.615 us in deterministic-default mode, with direct cells within run noise.

Select CUSOLVER_ALG_1 for persistent Xpotrf while retaining potrfBatched elsewhere and non-deterministic handle mode. Validation and guards passed, but the alternate algorithm raised batch=4,n=1024 from 1225.326 to 3024.125 us, batch=2,n=2048 to 3402.847 us, and n=4096 to 3891.740/7792.724 us; full geomean measured 1679.890 us.

Select CUSOLVER_ALG_2 for persistent Xpotrf. Validation and fresh-seed guards passed with the same residual profile as ALG_0. Full geomean measured 1292.037 us, essentially matching ALG_0/non-deterministic samples; looped cells were 1226.621, 1253.745, and 1431.382/2871.323 us.

Restore Xpotrf ALG_0 and deterministic-default mode, then extend looped Xpotrf to batch<=16,n=512 while retaining batched factorization for batch=640. Validation and guards passed. The batch=16,n=512 cell rose from about 576 us on potrfBatched to 2411.112 us; full geomean measured 1420.566 us.

Restore potrfBatched at n=512 and move the looped-Xpotrf cutoff from n>=1024 to n>=2048, measuring potrfBatched for both the low- and high-batch n=1024 cases. Validation and guards passed. Batch=4,n=1024 rose from about 1224 us on Xpotrf to 1265.622 us on potrfBatched; full geomean measured 1297.326 us.

Keep looped Xpotrf at n=1024 and n>=4096 but route n=2048 through potrfBatched to isolate that crossover. Validation and guards passed. Batch=2,n=2048 rose from about 1252 us with two Xpotrf calls to 3173.400 us with potrfBatched; full geomean measured 1378.027 us.

Restore looped Xpotrf for n=1024/2048 but route n=4096 through potrfBatched to isolate the largest direct crossover. Validation and guards passed. The n=4096 batch=1/2 cells rose from about 1430/2870 us on Xpotrf to 10242.443/11741.652 us on potrfBatched; full geomean measured 1624.160 us.

Restore looped Xpotrf for every batch<=4,n>=1024 direct shape and replace BF16x9 emulated FP32 with CUSOLVER_DEFAULT_MATH for workspace query and execution. Validation and guards passed. Full geomean measured 1297.935 us versus 1291.615 us with BF16x9; high-batch direct cells included 587.062 us at n=512 and 4955.134 us at n=2048.

Restore BF16x9 and allocate both persistent generic and classic workspaces, using Xpotrf for batch=1 but looped classic Spotrf for batch=2/4. Validation and guards passed. Full geomean measured 1293.718 us versus 1291.615 us with Xpotrf throughout; classic cells measured 1231.350 us at batch=4,n=1024, 1256.560 us at batch=2,n=2048, and 2874.425 us at batch=2,n=4096.

Attempt the inverse hybrid schedule, selecting classic Spotrf for batch=1 and Xpotrf for batch=2/4. Build passed, but the first implementation invoked Xpotrf for only the first matrix and official validation rejected both batch=2,n=1024 cases with reconstruction residuals 0.881 and 8.43. No benchmark was run.

Fix the inverse hybrid by looping Xpotrf over every matrix: use classic Spotrf for batch=1 and Xpotrf for batch=2/4 with separate persistent workspaces. Validation and guards passed. Full geomean measured 1293.625 us versus 1291.615 us with Xpotrf throughout; classic batch=1,n=4096 measured 1434.413 us while Xpotrf batch=2 cells measured 1255.643/2876.629 us.

Consolidate the measured all-Xpotrf low-batch schedule by removing the dual classic-workspace machinery while preserving ALG_0, BF16x9, and persistent device/host workspaces. Validation and guards passed. This semantically matches trial 0; a fresh full-grid sample measured 1296.993 us versus trial 0 at 1291.615 us, with the largest sampling shift at batch=8,n=2048 (4919.696 versus 4719.259 us).

Best commit e14b7cf measured 1291.615 us versus parent 9283c40 at 1292.701 us and passed all official tests plus fresh-seed guards; final consolidated equivalent f22fd41 passed and remeasured 1296.993 us amid high-batch variance. Persistent Xpotrf ALG_0 workspaces were slightly ahead of classic Spotrf at low batch. Crossovers were decisive: potrfBatched measured 1265.622 versus about 1225 us at batch=4,n=1024, 3173.400 versus about 1252 us at batch=2,n=2048, and 10242/11742 versus about 1430/2870 us at n=4096; looped Xpotrf lost at batch=8,n=2048 (5074.638 versus 4719.259) and batch=16,n=512 (2411.112 versus about 576). ALG_1 measured 1679.890, ALG_2 and non-deterministic mode about 1292.0, default math 1297.935, and classic/X hybrids about 1293.6-1293.7. One inverse-schedule implementation validation failure was logged and fixed. Local profiling remained waived by layout. Keep this line moving with separate math-mode selection for Xpotrf versus batched calls, n-specific handle-state minimization that survives Torch handle reuse, pinned host-workspace experiments, or group sizes between four and eight if future grids expose them.
